findings.title: Retry resource snapshots cannot resolve their registered plan
findings.evidence: validate_resources searches cohort.plans by attempt.session_id, but that inventory has primary session IDs only. checked_attempts already resolves retry_of to a primary slot and checks retry custody plan digest, then passes the retry session to validate_resources. A distinct-session retry with resources fails session snapshot lacks prepared plan.
findings.correction: Pass the already validated Slot or plan digest into resource validation; compare snapshot session to retry and snapshot plan to parent slot. Add a distinct-session retry control reaching resource validation.

findings.title: Evidence fields are displayed but not enforced by comparison eligibility
findings.evidence: custody_closed and diagnostics_ok are stored but omitted from evidence_complete, reasons, candidate_reference_eligible and eligible_for_measured_pair. Missing diagnostics attachment returns false without reason. A checked priced record/resource/relation can remain pair-eligible with absent diagnostic attachment or structurally unclosed ownership.
findings.correction: Keep derived finite arithmetic costs if useful, but separate raw priced data from comparison eligibility; derive required evidence blockers under the frozen contract and require those blockers absent for eligible fields. Do not redefine that policy during review.

findings.title: Incomplete sessions and partial retries abort export instead of being retained
findings.evidence: session_custody requires complete status,3240 records,last_seq3239 for every session. validate_session_attempt_coverage requires all3240 sequences for every retry session. A killed session or partial recovery cannot export its retained evidence even as ineligible rows, despite the advertised retained-failure boundary.
findings.correction: Separate expected primary enrollment from observed attempts and session closure. Preserve partial sessions with explicit missing slots/custody status; retries must not replace primaries. If complete-session-only scope is intended, amend and independently review that narrower contract prospectively.

findings.title: Candidate changed during independent review without preserved original snapshot
findings.evidence: Assigned manifest f57de9b056e286d43028b17f4387f8496a7e12edb3ddf37d776b01898656c0d9 and patch c99b64d73c7fbf338033f95f942623792ed2e6768dbd30fe41fe15b1e00a58f9 changed to b63943f0d46ebb5a5bcd806bd97028308240137e8b5900bc6dff3cd1d702ddec / c851c6a35ce2667f046f6b778268b42878806e07ef1e80841145f242308dac42. Producer confirmed no immutable original copy. Current bytes frozen independently in observed-after-drift; original review messages remain historical.
findings.correction: Preserve current observed snapshot and explicitly label unrecovered originals; reconstruct originals only if every original digest matches. Make any further changes a separately sealed successor.

source_checks: All seven actual hydrated prepared-plan files and validation receipt match registered digests; each plan has180workloads/3240executions, total1260/22680 with18900measured and3780warmup.
Slot building derives arm/role/method/seed/round/warmup/workload from checked plans; primary bijection and explicit retry parent checks replace caller aggregate counts.
FilePins open actual files, verify bytes and SHA256, reject duplicate JSON keys and deserialize native types.
DiagnosticChild and diagnostic_attachment/v2 use native serializers/bindings; resource PublicationTail::observed revalidates prefix semantics; ordinary records require native line seals.
Nine-category analyzer is called directly; null/partial price cells or mapper blockers keep finite cost null.
Cargo direction root->native_price->paired_export has no reverse root dependency in pinned manifests.
Six source-written controls cover smaller enrollment, retry parent, triplet identity, injected fields, null price cells and changed file bytes; they were not executed and do not cover R1/R2/R3.
source_scope_note: Nine bound donor/overlay schema+mapper files match actual bytes. runner.rs donor hash differs from git show at advertised repository head; this review used explicitly pinned donor source, not an assertion of compiled integration compatibility.
